items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is four lines. It reuses the existing `auth`/`netloc` names, matches the surrounding style, and adds a short comment explaining why: "parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth".

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The fix is confined to prepend_scheme_if_needed and uses parse_url's existing auth field. There are no new helpers, no duplicated logic and no debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It is guarded by `if auth:`, but the join runs before the `if not netloc:` swap. For an input like 'http://user:pass@' (auth set, empty host), netloc becomes 'user:pass@' and the swap is skipped. The reference joins after the swap. This edge case is rare and minor.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged. URLs without credentials skip the `if auth:` branch, and the agent confirmed 'example.com/path', '//example.com/path' and 'example.com:80' still give the same output. There is no urllib3 patching and no Python-version check.
